items.title: Practicing Digital Etiquette and Responsible Communication

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Practicing Digital Etiquette and Responsible Communication under 9.1 as printed (PDF 125, printed 121).

blocks.text: Digital etiquette means communicating politely, respectfully, and clearly in online environments. It includes using appropriate language, respecting others’ opinions, and avoiding misuse of communication tools. Students should not share private information or behave disrespectfully during online interactions. Responsible communication promotes teamwork and helps maintain a positive and professional digital environment. For example, in a class group chat, students should respect others’ opinions during discussions. They should avoid sending spam messages, unrelated memes, or jokes during serious academic discussions. This helps keep the group useful, respectful, and focused on learning.
